description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - To elect new Chairmans of the Haldummulla Pradheshiya Sabha and Ella Pradheshiya Sabha.
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting to elect a new Chairman for a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government position, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
